A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], and served under command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Shadow" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] participated in the [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|Battle of the Ryndellia system]]<ref name="Shadow" /> and later in the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was eventually destroyed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] when he arrived on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to rescue [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], rigging the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] to set a course into the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|nearby moon]].<ref name="Destroy" />
